Then, repeat often.

drafts.angle: Arrow-list workflow (rides @rauchg's 'This is how agents will ship all code', 75K and 982 bookmarks)
drafts.draft_en:
This is how agents will ship all ads.

→ Agent writes 500 creative variants
→ Verification gate before publish: brand rules, legal claims, platform policy
→ Approve, fix, or block. Every single one
→ Agent monitors spend and performance

Code got CI. Creative is getting it next.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical screen recording: a batch of AI ad variants flows left to right through a 'gate', each landing with an APPROVE / FIX / BLOCK badge in Aubric. Overlay the 4 arrow lines one at a time. Use only real product footage.

drafts.angle: Category reframe + agree-and-extend (rides @gregisenberg's 'all marketing now is just code and tokens', 30K and 535 bookmarks in under 3 hours)
drafts.draft_en:
If all marketing is now code and tokens, then every ad is a deploy.

And nobody ships a deploy without tests.

Brand rules, legal claims, platform policies: those are your tests. Run them on every creative before it goes live.
drafts.video_tip: 12s text-only vertical: 'every ad is a deploy' types out like a terminal command, then a green test-suite run with 3 checks (brand ✓, legal ✓, policy ✗ → fixed). Hold the last line for 3 seconds.

drafts.angle: Blunt '99%' one-liner (rides @AlexHormozi's '99% of problems...' 167K and 2.4K bookmarks)
drafts.draft_en:
99% of ad rejections are boring.

A banned word. A claim with no proof. A logo in the wrong color.

The brands that scale AI creative aren't smarter. They just catch the boring stuff before the platform does.
drafts.video_tip: 10s vertical, three quick cuts: a red-circled banned word, an unsupported claim, an off-brand logo, each with a 'caught' stamp. End on the first line as text. If you show real ads, only use ones you own or have permission to show.
